delay_fail_microseconds.description: Microseconds to delay on auth failure

issue_file_path.description: Path to issue file to display before login prompt (uncommented line if used)

faillock.description: Enable PAM faillock-based account lockout after failed login attempts. Configure thresholds and unlock delay. (If null, faillock is not configured.)

tally2.description: Enable legacy pam_tally2-based lockout (for older systems). Prefer faillock if available. (If null, tally2 is not configured.)

audit_rules.description: List of audit/access control rules for login (e.g., restrict login to specific users).
